# OpenProgram 0.6.3 Release Notes

Original version date: August 15, 2026. This tag continued the Intel macOS complete-runtime compatibility work, but the GUI dependency set still failed the release gate. It did not publish installable assets.

## 🐞 Bug fixes

- Adjusted the Intel-compatible Torch, NumPy, OpenCV, and syntax-parser dependency set.
- Expanded complete-runtime build support for Intel macOS.

## ⚠️ Release status

- The complete GUI runtime dependency constraints still did not pass every release gate.
- No GitHub Release or installable runtime assets were published.
- This tag is not an installable user version; all fixes are included in `v0.6.6`.

## 🔄 Version guide

- Previous release attempt: [`v0.6.2`](https://github.com/Fzkuji/OpenProgram/releases/tag/v0.6.2)
- Next release attempt: [`v0.6.4`](https://github.com/Fzkuji/OpenProgram/releases/tag/v0.6.4)
- Installable version: [`v0.6.6`](https://github.com/Fzkuji/OpenProgram/releases/tag/v0.6.6)
